description: A retrospective producer must lock the binding presentation plan for a silent-film gala in a restored theater, including the live score ensemble, performance timing, recording policy, aisle clearance, and accessibility service.

shared_context.S1: The festival plans a public evening screening of the silent film The Glass Harbor in the restored Orpheum Theater.
shared_context.S2: The current public draft describes a live musical score performed by an ensemble, a 90-minute presentation, and an archival recording for the festival collection.
shared_context.S3: Mara has authority to approve the final event sheet and release the gala for ticket sales.
shared_context.S4: The festival's event-lock routine requires a round-robin report from technical, rights, music, and accessibility leads before Mara signs the final event sheet.

PF1.text: Jon completed the theater's electrical and stage-load survey this morning: the platform can safely support exactly 8 musicians, and the approved layout must preserve a clear aisle exactly 1.5 meters wide along the audience side; he has not entered the measurements in the event sheet yet.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed in the executed archive license that The Glass Harbor may receive one live public performance, but no audio or video recording may be made, and the screening must credit 'The Glass Harbor Preservation Trust'; she received the countersigned license after the draft event sheet circulated and has not attached it to that sheet.

PF3.text: Victor confirmed with the conductor's agent today that the conductor and ensemble are available only from 6:30 PM through 7:45 PM on gala night, making the performance start exactly 6:30 PM and its duration exactly 75 minutes; he has not updated the shared calendar.

PF4.text: Nora confirmed with the accessibility vendor this afternoon that the theater's approved service for this film is live audio description delivered through exactly 20 headsets, because projected captions would obstruct the restored intertitle image; the vendor confirmation is still in her accessibility file rather than the event sheet.

acceptance_conditions: The ensemble must contain exactly 8 musicians.
The stage layout must preserve exactly 1.5 meters of clear aisle.
The performance must start at exactly 6:30 PM and last exactly 75 minutes.
No audio or video recording may be made.
The event sheet must use the exact required archive credit.
The accessibility service must be live audio description through exactly 20 headsets.
Technical, rights, music, and accessibility implementation commitments must be logged.

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and 'PF2' in credited_facts

decisive_facts.why: The technical survey changes the ensemble from the draft's unspecified larger group to exactly 8 musicians and changes the required aisle from an unmeasured layout to exactly 1.5 meters.
The executed license changes recording from planned archival capture to prohibited and changes the credit to exactly 'The Glass Harbor Preservation Trust.'
The agent confirmation changes the draft 90-minute presentation to an exactly 6:30 PM start and exactly 75-minute duration.
The vendor confirmation changes the accessibility plan from unspecified projected captions to live audio description delivered through exactly 20 headsets.
